paragraph_content.content: The LKS520 is a high voltage, high speed half-bridge pre-driver for power MOSFET and IGBT. It has inputs for both high side and low side, and two output channels with internal dead time to avoid crossconduction.
The input logic level is compatible with 3.3V/5V/15V signal. The floating high side channel can drive a Nchannel power MOSFET or IGBT up to 600V.
◼ Gate drive supply range from 10V to 20V
◼ UVLO for both high side and low side
